source: Sandbox landmarks, not a course or IALA navigation marks. Positions are world x (east) and z (south) in metres from the known departure, in 12-17 m of water, 1.3-1.5 km out in a ring around the start: N in the channel east of Great Holm and Holm Spit, NE off Eastport's approach, E off the east shore, S on the way to the bay mouth beside Little Holm Ledge, W toward Westcove. VISUAL ESTIMATE sizes (scaled with the spacing so they stay readable at that range), distinctive colours/topmarks and painted IDs for milestone 6 sighting and chart identification.
